title: 第8章 全家出动洗刷刷
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
蔡老太把剩下的盐巴递给大儿子。

    魏建业秒懂，指着退潮的一块海泥巴地说：“我领你们上那逮去，那也有蛏子，而且特别大！”

    他拍着心窝子担保要挖个十几公分长，至少有两指头粗的大蛏子。

    别说三孩子没见过，婆媳两个都寻思得开开眼界。

    搁老家那么些年，也只有逢年过节的时候拿到鱼票才能买点冻得邦邦硬的带鱼和黄鱼，干海带和干紫菜都算在海产品里头了，

    一家子打着赤脚跟着魏建业在海泥地里转悠。

    人还挺专业，找到个蛏子洞后没急着撒盐，瞧清楚蛏子洞的朝向才撒了盐巴，从距离蛏子透气口一指头外的位置开始挖，真截胡出条十五公分长的蛏王。

    苗苗看亲爸的眼神都有光了，喊：“爸，你真厉害。”

    魏建业心花怒放，“这才哪到哪，爸教你们抓。”

    蔡老太这回没应，“下一次再说，日头越来越晒了。”

    魏建业兴头上呢，完全抵抗不了儿子女儿那眼巴巴的眼神，说：“妈，没事，都穿长衣长裤，晒不着的。”

    他给三个小孩都发了盐巴，也给了赵玉兰一把，说：“我给你找个蛏子多的地方。”

    夫妻俩孩子都生三个了，这会还跟刚处对象似的红着脸走远了。

    蔡老太也不管两口子，她就盯着三孩子，时不时看看草帽捂严实了没有，还把毛巾绕着孩子脖子箍一圈。

    上辈子小老太其实也在海南岛养老过好几年，本地人才不会大晌午去海边折腾！

    蛏子的透气口比筷子头还小呢，三孩子就蹲着瞪圆了眼睛使劲找。

    一个浪花打过来，把苗苗和芽芽撞得一屁股坐下。

    芽芽摇摇晃晃的也没站稳当，直接面朝下翻了个大跟头，在海水里摔了个大马趴。

    蔡老太眼神就没从三孩子身上挪开过，伸出脚丫阻挡大孙子往海水里滚。

    这边动静大，那边夫妻俩都看见了。

    又是一个浪花打过来，赵玉兰低头看海浪，一刹那感觉自己在往前走，站都站不稳，头立马跟着发昏。

    夫妻俩现在是站在礁石上。

    边上的魏建业就知道自家媳妇晕浪了，赶紧伸手去捞，结果只抓到了裤腿。
content_en:
Mrs. Cai handed the remaining salt to her eldest son.

Wei Jianye understood instantly and pointed to a piece of sea mud at low tide and said, "I'll take you up there to catch them. There are razor clams there too, and they're really big!"

He patted his heart and promised to dig up a big razor clam more than ten centimeters long and at least two fingers thick.

Not to mention that the three children have never met before, both the mother-in-law and the daughter-in-law are eye-opening.

For so many years in my hometown, I could only buy some hard-frozen hairtail and yellow croaker when I got a fish ticket during the holidays. Dried kelp and dried seaweed were all included in the seafood.

The whole family followed Wei Jianye around the sea and mud in bare feet.

The man was quite professional. After finding a razor clam hole, he didn’t rush to spread the salt. He only sprinkled the salt after looking at the direction of the razor clam hole. He started digging from a fingertip away from the ventilation opening of the razor clam and finally found a 15 cm long razor clam king.

Miaomiao's eyes lit up when she saw her biological father, and she shouted, "Dad, you are so awesome."

Wei Jianye was elated, "Where are you? Dad will teach you how to catch him."

Mrs. Cai didn't respond this time, "I'll talk about it next time. The sun is getting hotter."

Wei Jianye was so happy that he couldn't resist the eager looks in his son's and daughter's eyes, and said, "Mom, it's okay. They are all wearing long clothes and trousers, so they can't be exposed to the sun."

He gave salt to all three children, gave a handful to Zhao Yulan, and said, "I'll find you a place with lots of razor clams."

The couple already had three children, and they walked away with a blushing face as if they had just been with each other.

Old Mrs. Cai didn't care about the couple. She just stared at the three children, checking from time to time whether the straw hat was tightly covered, and wrapping the towel around the children's necks.

In her previous life, the little old lady actually lived in Hainan Island for several years, and local people would not go to the beach in the middle of the day!

The ventilation opening of the razor clam was smaller than the head of a chopstick, so the three children squatted and searched hard with their eyes wide.

A wave hit, knocking Miaomiao and Yaya down.

Yaya staggered and did not stand firm. She turned face down and fell flat on her back in the sea water.

Mrs. Cai never took her eyes away from her three children and stretched out her feet to stop her eldest grandson from rolling into the sea.

There was a lot of movement here, and the couple saw it there.

Another wave came over. Zhao Yulan looked down at the waves. For a moment, she felt like she was walking forward. She couldn't stand firmly and her head immediately felt dizzy.

The couple are now standing on the rocks.

Wei Jianye, who was standing next to him, knew that his wife was dizzy, so he quickly reached out to fish for her, but he only caught the trouser leg.
title_en: Chapter 8 The whole family goes out to clean up
